caption: The drawing features a hexagonal, pouch-like object placed centrally on a plain off-white background. The object is bordered by a thick, vibrant pink edge, which is surrounded by a thin black outline broken at intervals. Inside this border, there are several layers of decorative patterns, including a golden brown zigzag band, a blue band with white zigzag stitching, and an inner black field containing additional embellishments. Within the central black area, there is a large green-edged heart outlined in pink, containing an inner black heart with gold geometric lines. On both sides of the heart, there are symmetrical, curling green and pink shapes. Surrounding the heart and positioned symmetrically, two blue circular floral motifs are present, with two additional green floral-like shapes placed above the heart. Four sets of black dotted lines extend from the sides and lower corners of the hexagonal object, suggesting the presence of tied strings or tassels. The overall composition is symmetrical and contains rich, contrasting colors such as black, gold, pink, green, and blue. The lower right corner of the drawing contains a handwritten signature.
title: Reticule
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
